headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录249篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究157篇, 开源项目46篇, 模型发布34篇, 产品/API12篇。热门标签：Agent（61篇）。其中8%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ tech-leads-club /agent-skills：The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents. Extend Antigravity, Claude C

▸ melgarafael /DeskcommCRM：Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative 

▸ calesthio /OpenMontage：World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700

▸ asgeirtj /system_prompts_leaks：Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. Open

▸ vxcontrol /pentagi：Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
